identityStatus: OpenStreetMap way 654074791 fixes the current footprint and its rotation. Public-domain printed illustration and the historic register document the rectangular rubble-limestone envelope.

notes: The Pawnee vignette in the 1896 Kansas Souvenir shows original massing and opening rhythm. The federal survey and register document the restored roof, sashes, central doors and surviving stone.
